top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Listing (26 TAC §742.403(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not verified liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §747.3301(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation that diapers are not promptly changed.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child in care did not have an immunization record available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver stated that one of the infants has been sleeping in a swing instead of a play yard. This was corrected during the inspection when the primary caregiver was informed that infants cannot sleep in swings without a sleep expection form signed by a doctor.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver was missing training for the previous training year in the following topics:  Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome,  Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS),  Understanding early childhood brain development.
